description: This file defines the JobCategoryAPI class, a RESTful API endpoint for managing job categories within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It implements CRUD operations (create, retrieve, update, delete) for job categories, including validation, serialization, and integration with the underlying service layer.

classes.name: JobCategoryAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class providing CRUD operations for JobCategory entities, including methods for fetching, creating, updating, and deleting job categories, with validation and serialization support.

methods.name: getJobCategoryService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the JobCategoryService instance used to perform business logic and data operations related to JobCategory.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single JobCategory by ID, returning its model wrapper or throws a RecordNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getOne method, ensuring the ID parameter is positive.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Fetches a list of JobCategories with optional sorting and pagination parameters, returning a collection result including total count.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for list retrieval, including sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new JobCategory with provided data and returns its serialized model.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validation rules for creating a new JobCategory, primarily validating the 'name' parameter.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing JobCategory by ID with new data and returns its serialized model.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating an existing JobCategory, including uniqueness constraints on 'name'.

methods.name: saveJobCategory
methods.description: Helper method to assign the 'name' parameter to a JobCategory entity and persist it.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Constructs validation rule for 'name' parameter, including length and uniqueness constraints.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more JobCategories based on provided IDs and returns the list of deleted IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rule for delete operation, validating presence of IDs.
